title: dictyogramme manniana
intro: Dictyogramme manniana, commonly known as Lion's Tail, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of anxiety, insomnia, and fever, due to its therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of Dictyogramme manniana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
